item.title: Rollouts and Security Review
item.description: Two bots for the last mile of shipping code: Rollouts watches every change as it deploys, and Security Review reports exploitable bugs on every pull request.
item.content:encoded:
Today we're launching two Cursor bots for the last mile of shipping code. Rollouts watches every change as it deploys and reports its health per environment. Security Review reports exploitable bugs on every pull request.

Both are available today on Teams and Enterprise plans.

item.title: Cursor Projects
item.description: Projects lets you take on larger bodies of work, maintain context over months, and delegate tasks to thousands of subagents.
item.content:encoded:
